pages.text: Place it $(l)on any side of a hive$() by clicking the hive's face: the spout points away from the hive. Placed on its own it points down, for a hive on top.$(br2)When the hive is full it harvests it in one go, as if sheared, without angering the bees, and pushes the items out of the spout like a hopper.

$(l)Comb mode$() takes the combs. $(l)Honey mode$() fills two glass bottles per harvest instead, or one from a vanilla beehive (the combs are lost). Right-click with bottles to load it (it holds 64); hoppers can feed it from the sides.$(br2)Right-click with an empty hand to switch modes.
